VI. STEPS TAKEN TO MINIMIZE IMPACTS
Relocation Assistance
The Wisconsin Division of Highways, under both state and federal laws, has the principle responsibility of providing assistance of those persons, businesses, non-profit organizations, and others who may be relocated as a result of the acquisition of lands for public highway improvements.
The entire program is more fully explained in their free sixteen-page relocation assistance brochure. Briefly, the provisions are that the Division of Highways will make prompt, fair and reasonable relocation payments, and personally assist affected persons to relocate by making available to them all information, services and facilities necessary.
The Division of Highways provides the following assistance to all displacees:
1. Counsel each individual and family with regard to their specific rehousing needs resulting in each securing replacement housing that is decent, safe and sanitary; adequate for their needs; suitably located; and within their financial means.
2. The relocation agents will locate and provide leads to replacement housing in the area or areas desired by each displacee and make referrals to those units that are comparable and decent, safe and sanitary.
3. Displacees will be referred to local welfare and social service assistance agencies when there appears a need for such services.
4. Contact with each displacee will be made at least weekly during which various leads or referrals will be offered.
